record.question: The maxim 'Qui facit per alium facit per se' means
options: Act of an agent is act of all of the agents and thereby all of them becomes vicariously liable for the act of any one of them
Act of an agent is the act of the principal and thereby makes the principal vicariously liable for the acts of the agent
Act of one tortfeasor is the act of another tortfeasor and both are equally liable for the act of each other
A tortious act makes a person liable per se and no evil motive is needed to be proved

appearance.canonical_answer_text: Act of an agent is the act of the principal and thereby makes the principal vicariously liable for the acts of the agent
